feed.title: Maine Legislature — Laws of Maine (Session/Chaptered Law)
feed.subtitle: This is a Durandal/Breeze single-page app; the static HTML shell does not change when content updates, so page-fingerprint monitoring will likely under-report changes. API RECON (2026-08): the SPA talks to a Breeze service at /ros/LawsOfMaine/breeze/Law/ — getLegislatures returns live JSON, but getLawGroup returned empty for every legislature/session/type/chapter combination tried (GET and POST). If a future attempt maps working getLawGroup parameters, this source can be converted to structured per-law items like leg-hearings-schedule.
